content.title: About
content.content: Popcorn Microwave NFS (2985) is a ready‑to‑cook grain snack designed for microwave ovens. The bag contains pre‑selected corn kernels coated with a flavorful seasoning that pop in 2–3 minutes, creating light, crunchy pieces.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Popcorn is the only type of corn whose kernels explode when heated due to high internal moisture.
Microwave popcorn appeared in the 1980s and quickly became popular for its convenience and speed.
In the United States more than 13 billion servings of popcorn are consumed each year, a large share of which is microwave popcorn.
NFS popcorn features a proprietary spice blend developed with food technologists.
Each serving provides about 100 kcal, making it a popular light snack.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Unlike oil‑popped popcorn, microwave popcorn is prepared without added oil, reducing overall fat content.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Corn kernels are rich in dietary fiber, which supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Popcorn contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The carbohydrates in popcorn are quickly digestible, providing a rapid source of energy.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Corn is naturally gluten‑free, making this product suitable for people with celiac disease.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some flavored varieties contain a notable amount of salt; those monitoring sodium intake should choose low‑salt options.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Although rare, corn allergy can occur and may manifest as skin reactions or breathing difficulties.

items.title: Burn risk
items.content: Hot steam released from the bag after cooking can cause burns; allow a few minutes to cool before opening.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Certain flavors may include artificial flavorings and preservatives; select versions with minimal ingredients if this matters to you.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Place the bag in the microwave and cook for 2–3 minutes, then carefully open the bag to let the steam escape. Eat the popcorn as is, or add grated cheese, extra spices, or a small amount of melted butter to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened bag in a dry, cool place away from moisture. After opening, transfer any remaining popcorn to an airtight container to keep it crunchy and prevent it from absorbing odors.
